title: rbGyanX: A research framework for radiobiological evaluation of radiotherapy plans (TCP/NTCP) from DICOM-RT
description:
rbGyanX is a research framework for radiobiological evaluation of radiotherapy plans (TCP/NTCP) from DICOM-RT. It integrates physical dosimetry, radiobiological modelling (TCP/NTCP) and explainable machine learning for treatment plan evaluation in radiation oncology.

For research use only. Not a medical device and not intended for clinical decision-making.
notes: For research use only. Not a medical device and not intended for clinical decision-making. Study data and results are not distributed in the source repository; see the reproduction capsule.
